title: Formula-level SAT reduction to minimum-weight monotone 2-CNF
claims: SATReducibleToMonotoneTwoCNFWeightSemantics establishes a semantic equisatisfiability reduction with an exact distinct-name weight threshold.
The target uses only positive clauses of width at most two and the budget equals the original number of literal occurrences plus one.
The statement supplies a checked semantic component and does not assert that the raw-word constructor is polynomial-time.
P_subset_NP is independently checked using pinned definitions.
